# MetaGen Digital

> Bangladesh's leading digital marketing agency — web development, social media, photography & videography, and e-commerce solutions.

MetaGen Digital (metagendigital.com) helps businesses grow online through custom web/app development, digital marketing, branding, and creative production services. The site is available in English (default) and Bengali (`/bn/*` prefix).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://metagendigital.com/): Overview of services and the agency
- [Services](https://metagendigital.com/services): Full service catalog
- [Portfolio](https://metagendigital.com/portfolio): Case studies and past work
- [Products](https://metagendigital.com/products): Productized offerings
- [Pricing](https://metagendigital.com/pricing): Plans and pricing
- [About](https://metagendigital.com/about): Company background and team
- [Blog](https://metagendigital.com/blog): Articles and updates
- [Careers](https://metagendigital.com/careers): Open positions
- [Contact](https://metagendigital.com/contact): Get in touch

## Notes for automated/agentic access

- Full sitemap: https://metagendigital.com/sitemap_index.xml
- robots.txt allows crawling of all public pages; `/dashboard`, `/auth/*` and `/api/*` are private and excluded
- Structured data (JSON-LD) is present on pages for organization, breadcrumb, and FAQ content
